snippet.title: Fox Arcana - New Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
FOX ARCANA is a pixel art roguelike survivor. You play a fox against hordes of monsters, backed by the creatures you free, in a world that shifts to a new season with every boss you defeat.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3248700/Fox_Arcana?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=trailer
